scope.reviewed: cap leaf and wrapper, exact row/item addressing, valid/split cap selection, type-7 bypass and returns

findings.result: Independent decode and address extraction confirm leaf [5C1E,5C56) derives row from context+12 plus index*144 and item from row+4 plus slot*10. It loads validity byte row+122 and split byte row+58; only validity==1 and slot>=split select cap halfword6, otherwise cap halfword4. Unsigned comparison stores selected cap only if item halfword0 is greater. Leaf R0 returns selected cap; R4/R5/SP restore.

Wrapper [5C56,5C72) skips the leaf for row byte123==7 and returns incoming index. Otherwise it forwards index, slot and context to the leaf. The corrected candidate and isolated 324 fixtures agree on offset58 (not the separate bulk-cap field offset), return values, complete item bytes, R4 and SP.
All source/body/file pins passed; isolated replay JSON is byte-identical and both complete Thumb extents independently decode.

limitations: No index or slot validation is present; fixtures cover only indices0..2 and slots0,1,3.
The split byte at +58 is instruction-backed but its allocation/record role is not established; it lies beyond the nominal 144-byte stride.
Aliasing, concurrent mutation, physical meaning, canonical admission and C implementation remain unresolved.
